description: Structure plus the per-pair values every status is derived from. A decider re-derives every count, status, fact and the outcome from the pairs and the lists and rejects any difference; gates are necessary, not sufficient. exampleOnly=true marks synthetic illustrations that a production decider rejects.

continueScope.const: CONTINUE means at most that no performance regression was found on the decision-bearing rows, together with the C1 result, given the registered correctness and baseline checks it also requires. It says nothing about maintainability or any other non-performance value.

killReap.const: A faster Rust kill/reap may come from an implementation choice, not from the language: the Python backend scans the whole host process table with psutil on every kill (`terminals.py kill()` → `_descendant_pids`), a step that Python could also remove or bound. It is not evidence that the language is faster.
